name: ferrocloud-console
description: The ferrocloud web console. The TypeScript here is bundled into console.js, which is committed so building the emulator needs no Node.

scripts.build: esbuild main.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=es2022 --charset=utf8 --legal-comments=none --banner:js="// Built from crates/cloud/console/*.ts by 'npm run build': don't edit by hand." --outfile=console.js
